From ec0bbc5ec5664dcee344f79373852117dc672c86 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Steven Rostedt (Google)" <rostedt@goodmis.org>
Date: Tue, 27 Sep 2022 19:15:25 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] ring-buffer: Check pending waiters when doing wake ups as
 well

The wake up waiters only checks the "wakeup_full" variable and not the
"full_waiters_pending". The full_waiters_pending is set when a waiter is
added to the wait queue. The wakeup_full is only set when an event is
triggered, and it clears the full_waiters_pending to avoid multiple calls
to irq_work_queue().

The irq_work callback really needs to check both wakeup_full as well as
full_waiters_pending such that this code can be used to wake up waiters
when a file is closed that represents the ring buffer and the waiters need
to be woken up.

Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20220927231824.209460321@goodmis.org

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Cc: Ingo Molnar <mingo@kernel.org>
Cc: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>
Fixes: 15693458c4bc0 ("tracing/ring-buffer: Move poll wake ups into ring buffer code")
Signed-off-by: Steven Rostedt (Google) <rostedt@goodmis.org>

diff --git a/kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c b/kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c
index 02db92c9eb1b..5a7d818ca3ea 100644
--- a/kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c
+++ b/kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c
@@ -917,8 +917,9 @@ static void rb_wake_up_waiters(struct irq_work *work)
 	struct rb_irq_work *rbwork = container_of(work, struct rb_irq_work, work);
 
 	wake_up_all(&rbwork->waiters);
-	if (rbwork->wakeup_full) {
+	if (rbwork->full_waiters_pending || rbwork->wakeup_full) {
 		rbwork->wakeup_full = false;
+		rbwork->full_waiters_pending = false;
 		wake_up_all(&rbwork->full_waiters);
 	}
 }
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c`**
- The function `rb_wake_up_waiters` was modified to include an additional condition in the `if` statement. 
- The condition now checks both `rbwork->full_waiters_pending` and `rbwork->wakeup_full` before executing the wake-up logic for full waiters.
- If either condition is true, it sets `rbwork->wakeup_full` to false and also sets `rbwork->full_waiters_pending` to false.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modification enhances the wake-up logic for waiters in the ring buffer by ensuring that both the `full_waiters_pending` and `wakeup_full` states are considered when waking up waiters. This change addresses a potential issue where waiters might not be woken up correctly when a file representing the ring buffer is closed, thereby improving the robustness of the wake-up mechanism. The patch is a fix for a previously introduced change (identified by the Fixes tag) that did not account for the pending waiters, which could lead to missed wake-up calls.

It fails to consider the `full_waiters_pending` state, which indicates that there are waiters that need to be notified but may not be due to the absence of an event triggering `wakeup_full`. This oversight can lead to waiters remaining blocked when they should be woken up, especially when a file representing the ring buffer is closed.

```

```

The fix modifies the condition to check both `full_waiters_pending` and `wakeup_full`. Additionally, resetting `full_waiters_pending` to false ensures that the state is correctly managed, preventing future wake-up calls from being missed.
